kjv.text: The LORD hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.

bsb.text: The LORD has done great things for us; we are filled with joy.

web.text: The LORD has done great things for us, and we are glad.

flow.text: Henry shows how God's people speak differently about what God does than outsiders do. They speak as those who benefit and belong.
Observe here, God's appearances for his people are to be looked upon as great things.
God himself is the one who makes these great things happen for his church.
God is to be eyed as the author of all the great things done for the church.
When we see God's work as done for us, we can truly rejoice in it the way his people do.
It is good to observe how the church's deliverances are for us, that we may rejoice in them.

morning.say: Carry into today the thought that God's deliverances are for you to rejoice in.
morning.phrase: God's appearances for his people are to be looked upon as great things

leads.kjv: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy is his name.
Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the LORD; awake, as in the ancient days, in the generations of old. Art thou not it that hath cut Rahab, and wounded the dragon?
And when ye see this, your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall flourish like an herb: and the hand of the LORD shall be known toward his servants, and his indignation toward his enemies.
